column1: # Source: Dairy Trust Taranaki, DTT Stratford site.
# 'DTT Stratford Monthly Pasture Growth (Kg DM/ha/day) - Past 11 Years'

# pasture growth rate at a dairy research farm in Stratford, Taranaki.

# dairy-proxy caveat still applies to grazing type. BUT it is real, dated,
# Taranaki-specific data - not a fabricated citation like the prior
